$description: shauna.dev design tokens. Single source of truth: scripts/tokens.mjs generates src/styles/tokens.css from this file before every build. DESIGN.md explains the rules.

$colorGroups.$description: How the colours are organised (2026-11-02, Shauna: fewer colours). base: the real palette, by Day value. roles: each role names the base colour it uses by Day (roles split apart in Dusk, which is why several share a base). component: colours for one component only (browser frame, terminal, pins card). art: rescue case study artwork only, never text. scripts/tokens.mjs fails if a role's Day value doesn't match its base.

font.display: 'DM Serif Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
font.label: 'LINE Seed JP', system-ui, sans-serif
font.hero: 'DM Serif Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

tracking.$description: Letter-spacing scale. Every letter-spacing in v2 code is one of these or 0 (check:ui fails the build otherwise).
tracking.label: 0.14em

wordmark.$description: The logo wordmark: LINE Seed JP caps next to the S mark, the same as shauna.digital (2026-10-24; was Archivo). Use the .wordmark class from v2.css; set only size and colour where it is used.
wordmark.$lockup: Logo lockup spec, shared by shauna.dev and shauna.digital (Shauna, 2026-10-20, option B from the brand review). All in em of the name's font-size: S mark height, gap, the pull on each side of the period (shauna.digital only), plus the minimum name size (below it, use the S alone) and the clear space around the lockup. Only font-size and colours change per placement.

device.$note: The one phone frame (2026-10-24). Values are % of the phone's own width (cqw), so every size has the same shape. Bezel in --deep, no notch.

contrast.$description: Every text colour on every surface it is used on. check:ui fails the build below 4.5:1. accent is graphics and large text only (it is checked here anyway); live is a graphic dot, never text.

type.$description: Twelve sizes. Since 2026-10-24 (Shauna) the type is shauna.digital's: DM Serif Display (400, sentence case) for every heading and big number, LINE Seed JP (400 and 700, 800 for the wordmark) for everything else. Unbounded Light in capitals is kept for the homepage pins headline only (font token 'pins'). check:ui fails the build on any other size.

pins.use: The homepage pins headline only (Unbounded Light, capitals, the zigzag). Added 2026-10-20.

hero.use: Big numbers in case study results

step.use: Every smaller heading: cards, decisions, parts, jobs, blog titles

dusk.$description: Dusk theme: the same roles at night. Every colour above can be overridden here; scripts/tokens.mjs emits them under :root[data-theme="dusk"]. check:ui runs every contrast pair against both themes. "white" and "on-deep" stay white on purpose: deep surfaces (footer, terminals) are dark in both themes.

voice.$description: Spoken replies (DESIGN.md, Voice and sound). The eval in eval/voice scores against these.

sound.$description: Sine tones, one per motion speed. Frequencies in Hz; length comes from the motion token.

haptic.$description: navigator.vibrate patterns in ms (on, off, on). Only with Sounds on.
